significance: A Digambar Jain pilgrimage complex of roughly fifty temples on and around a hill northeast of Damoh, centred on the colossal Rishabhanatha image known as Bade Baba. The shrine was renovated around 1700 with help from the Bundela ruler Chhatrasal.
story: Jain tradition holds that Shridhar Kevali, the last of the omniscient ones, attained liberation here.
